steps: After failing her exam, Iris drifted through dead-end jobs. Though finally offered a place at a prestigious institute, she turned it down and chose to become a Trekker with her friends after reuniting with them...
10:00, Floris Month 20th, Gold District in Emor, Grace Light Academy
One point below the cutoff...==W== I-I failed? How?==B====W== Excuse me, I need a score review.
Of course.==W== It is a pity, though. You nearly made the cutoff with only five subjects.==W== If you'd taken the last one, you might have passed.
Wait,==W== the...==W== The last exam?==W== What do you mean?==W== I took all five!
You must be mistaken.==W== The entrance exam always has six subjects.==W== That hasn't changed once in the academy's history.
You missed the last one: Grace Spells.==W== Shame.==W== That exam is pure memorization.==W== Judging by your other scores, you would have aced it.
(No... I couldn't have forgotten a subject.==W== Wait. Back then...)
It took us days to get here, and it'll take days to go back. We can't afford any mistakes. We need to get this right the first time.
Besides, I had fun climbing with you. They say wishes work better when you're happy. I appreciate you looking out for me,==W== but I'm making this wish.
Thanks to you both, I think I did well on all five subjects. The wish didn't seem to erase any of my book knowledge. Guess I got lucky this time.
(The memory I lost wasn't the exam material. It was the list of subjects...)
I didn't remember leaving Grace Light Academy. I didn't remember taking that business trip for my part-time job, either.
Next thing I knew, I was working in Port Bellin.
(If only I hadn't made that wish.)
I still think that sometimes. But dwelling on it now won't change a thing.
(I was overjoyed back then. Too full of myself. I actually thought I was good at something...)
(This must be fate... Punishment from the God of Grace.)
(... No. Noya and Amber only came to help me. It wouldn't be fair for them to lose their memories too.)
(So this isn't even... Yeah. This doesn't even count as a punishment.)
That part-time job ended fast. I started looking for work in other cities and never went back to Emor.
I was too ashamed to face everyone at the orphanage. I had no money to send back. But...
Looking at your resume... You have no formal education.
Born in the Ash District... Sorry, I don't think we're a good fit...
No recommendation letters? Okay. Let's stop here for today. If we decide to move forward, we'll send a notice to your address via a Trekker.
Most applications were tossed before my resume even reached a desk. The few times that I got to interviews, they barely looked at me.
All those certificates I paid Dorra for, all those late nights studying… Completely useless.
In the end, the Grace Imperium took me in.
A Soul Shop from Emor needed someone to run a mobile station in a nearby city, recharging Soul Stones with Grace.
So I became a glorious Soul Shop—
21:00, Gelu Month 24th, Silver District in Canosa, Commercial Street
Brr, freezing. Snow's coming down hard. It's Snowish Festival Eve, isn't it...==W== Wonder how Noya and Amber are doing.==W== Hope they're bundled up tonight, or they'll catch a cold.
Dead again tonight.==W== Everyone's switching to the cheaper Neo Solution instead of Grace. Tough making a living at a Soul Shop these days.
(Funny thing is, I'm officially a clerk for Soul Shop #305 in the Emor region, but I've never stepped inside. Never even been back to Emor.)
(Never even got a uniform. I set up a little folding table in nearby cities and take whatever comes. Scraping by, day after day.)
(But I've been Employee of the Month three times.==W== One more, and maybe I'll finally get a permanent spot.)
Oh, hello! Need a Grace refill?
Good evening. You must be Iris.==W== I'm from Grace Imperium HR.==W== There's something important that I need to inform you.
Yes, I'm Iris, clerk at Soul Shop #305. How can I help you?

I'll be direct.==W== To navigate current market challenges and maintain our competitive edge, the Sky Institute is restructuring. We are pivoting to a core-focus, cost-reduction strategy. Unfortunately, this involves large-scale layoffs and downsizing.
Consequently, your branch, Soul Shop #305 in Emor, has been permanently shut down.
W-Wait, what?==W== Shut down?==W== Then where do I go?
We all recognize and appreciate your hard work out here.==W== But unfortunately, since you aren't a full-time employee of Sky Institute, we cannot offer you an internal transfer.
Per company policy, we will provide you with the same severance package as our regular staff.==W== We hope you understand.
B-But...!==W== ... Okay. I understand. Thank you.
Whenever I got overwhelmed, I pulled out an old entrance exam for Grace Light Academy.
Tests always have a right answer. Study hard, learn the patterns, and you can solve even the toughest problems eventually.
But my life doesn't seem to have one.
Apply, fail. Apply, fail. Apply, fail. Apply, succeed... Become an outsourced worker.
A different-colored badge makes you invisible. And the snacks in the breakroom aren't meant for invisible people.
Even so, I still gravitated toward companies with Emor in the name,==W== or agencies without a Seal of Grace that tried to look like real corporations.
That name made me feel like they might take me back.
17:30, Sonus Month 25th, Port Bellin, Employment Agency
What about this job in Philae? It is United Harvest. Huge corporation.
A job that enticing... Would they even take someone like me?==W== I've heard that ...==W== a lot of these Philae jobs are covers to send you to the Lushwood Jungle.
Oh, you know your stuff, kid.==W== But the Lushwood Jungle is a solid option. Room, board, and travel are all covered. Work is easy, no degree required. If you can use a phone, you're hired.
They'll train you when you get there. You'll be making Dorra before you know it.
Oh. I see...==W== I'll pass on that. Do you have anything else?
Hmph. Picky, are we?==W== By the look of you, you got fired and haven't landed a thing since.
No, I wasn't fired. The agency shut down.==W== And I'm not being picky, I'm just...
Tons of agencies are doing fine. So why is yours the only one that goes under?==W== Are you a jinx?==W== Everywhere you go, it falls apart.
Jobs are everywhere.==W== Take a good look at yourself.==W== Have you improved yourself? Have you put in the effort?
Good. Now you know you're unwanted.==W== So what about that Philae job? Sign here and you're set.
A familiar hand pressed down on mine, stopping the pen.
Seriously! We've been looking for you for two months. I can't believe you almost fell for this scammer.
What are you talking about? You out-of-town Trekkers have zero respect.
I was helping this lazy girl find a job that suits her.
Don't act like you know her. Iris is the hardest worker I've ever met!
Back at the orphanage, she studied late every single night. Always the last one to sleep and the first one up.
She memorized obscure travel facts most Trekkers don't even know. When I decided to hit the road, she walked me through everything!
You sit here tricking people into dangerous jobs.==W== What gives you the right to call her lazy?!
Keep your voice down... Her being unemployed speaks for itself, doesn't it?
What is this...==W== Wait, an interview invite? With the official Eye of Grace seal?!
See? She is in high demand!==W== Hmph! Talk trash about her again and I'll bite you.==B====W== Come on, Iris, let's ditch this scammer.

Hey, hold on! If she has an Eye of Grace invite, why is she looking for work here?==W== Wait...==W== If those crazy professors find out I tried to ship their candidate off to the Lushwood Jungle...==W== I better pack my bags and run!
18:00, Sonus Month 25th, Port Bellin, Sunset Street
Noya, Amber, what are you doing here?==W== What do you mean you spent two months looking for me?==W== And what is the deal with that invitation?
One question at a time! I promise I'll explain everything,==W== but first...==W== Check this out!
Is that ... an Artifact car?!==W== Noya, did you actually build it?!
No. Only the shell. Inside's empty.
Hey, don't ruin the magic! Let her be amazed for a second.

Alright, alright.==W== Over these past few months, I wished for Artifact parts at the Monolith, and Amber dug up some ancient treasure. We barely managed to piece it together.==W== Now we fill up the inside, and it's good to go.
Oh, by the way. While we were putting it together, we ran into someone from the Eye of Grace.
Yeah! We mentioned we were your friends,==W== and she handed over this invite.
This expiration date makes me a little nervous... Let's see what it says...

Please excuse this abrupt letter. Your performance on the Grace Light Academy entrance exam left a profound impression on us. We were disappointed to learn that you were not admitted, which is why we are reaching out now.==P== If you are currently seeking employment, we may be able to offer a suitable position. We warmly invite you for an interview to discuss future possibilities.==P== Sincerely, The Society for the Study of Life
Sounds like they operate under the Eye of Grace. We only chatted for a bit,==W== so I don't know the exact details, but the lady was incredibly polite. I think they are legit.
Study notes... Do you still have them? She said they wanted to discuss the exam questions.
I do, I do.==W== I carry them with me everywhere...
This was everything I'd ever wanted. Right in front of me. With this invitation, they wouldn't care about my degree or where I come from.
I'd done so many Grace Light Academy's past papers that I can basically recite them in my sleep. I can definitely answer all of their questions.
Why did I do all this? All those practice questions… What was the point?
If it was all to get one answer correct on a test someone else wrote for me… Is that what I want?
... I don't know. How do I find the answer I'm after? The answer to my own life?
By the way, Iris.==W== Let me clear something up so you don't get the wrong idea.
We didn't spend two months tracking you down to hand-deliver a letter.
Huh? You didn't?==W== Then... What for?
What do you mean "what for"? Are you serious?==W== Didn't you hear me back there?==W== "She is in high demand!"==W==
...==W== Wait!==W== You seriously don't get it?!
Err? Um... Sorry. I'm not following.
No, no, no!==W== Right here!==W== In front of you!==W== Two people who need you!
Took you long enough... But you got there.
When putting together that car, Noya kept talking about you. ==W==She's been looking for you to join the guild.
If you hadn't told me that thing was a steering wheel, none of this would've happened.==W== On my own, I'd never have found those blueprints in the basement.
So when I decided to start my own guild...==W== I knew right then I wanted you with me!
But hey, I've got my dreams, and if you've got yours, no pressure!
Anyway, that's the deal. Go to your interview, I won't stop you.==W== But if you end up hating it at that Society or whatever,==W== I'd be thrilled if you kept us in mind as a backup plan♪
If you aren't happy there, we'll steal you away.
Ooh, I love that!==W== So cool! Done deal!!
... Thank you both!==W== I...==W== I've made up my mind!
Uh...==W== You tossed your study materials? ==W==You're not doing exams?
I love exam papers. They're my favorite thing. They make me feel safe.
I wanted to get into a big corporation. I wanted to stay in Emor. I wanted to see the orphanage every single day.
But what I want most ...==W== is just ...==W== to be with my two favorite people, Noya and Amber, forever.
Even if we go a whole day without talking, knowing you're nearby... That feeling is enough.
Noya, Amber, I've decided. I want to be a Trekker.
I'm done solving problems with standard answers.==W== The answer to my life is something I need to find myself.
Nope, the answer to OUR lives.==W== If you become a Trekker, the rest of our lives is one big exam for the three of us...
And—==W==we get to decide the answers.
Yeah!==W== Then, Noya, Amber...==W== I'm counting on you from here on out!
